reviews.text: Dr. White has very high ethical standards and is a compassionate and caring Veterinarian! Adm staff is amazing. HOWEVER, be aware to clip/grind a small dog's nails by a technician; no consultation with the vet,  cost me 60$ !
Great Vet! I have a diabetic dog and needed extra care, attention, and training with how to care for her.  The entire staff is excellent.

My dog had a stage three mass Cell tumor on her upper mandible and it had metastasized to the lymph node.
Dr. White did an incredible job, we consulted about Fenbindenzole  a edge-case treatment - if she lived six months then it will be profound. Right now it’s been three and she’s never had more energy . Not to mention, he saved me thousands instead of using Gulf Coast or VEG. Doctors will give you the runaround and put knowledge gatekeepers in your line to quick and resolute treatment options. It’s their duty, but it’s your duty to know. Take a step back away from your emotions and reason. Going into any doctors appointment, especially Dr. White, with a solid foundation and understanding of the case-therefore you can make strategic and informed decisions going forward. Not to mention Dr. White is a bit of a “chatty Kathy,” which I love and that he’s very old-school, but nonetheless HE IS willing to listen. That’s hard to come by these days and I’m very happy with our result.

Complete nightmare experience with this place. Dropped my dog off to get his teeth cleaned and told them I do not want any of his teeth removed because he is older. I show up several hours later and he is missing two teeth and completely out of it. I saw he was being held in a cage where there was poop everywhere. I dropped him off at 8am and could not pick him up until 6pm and when I showed up the front desk person said he still wasn’t ready. They held him for 10 hours for a teeth cleaning?! No one knew why his teeth were taken out and I still have not received a call back why they were taken out without even calling me. This place is very disorganized and will never be going back.

We reached 10:55 for a 11:00 AM appointment for our dog and as soon as we got there, they gave us the paperwork to fill which we filled in a couple of minutes. After that, we waited an hour and still could not see the doctor, if you give an appointment at 11 o’clock you cannot make a patient wait for one hour just to see a doctor and if you’re going to be late to see the patient, let us know upfront that it’s going to be late so we can leave or reschedule. Finally we left without seeing the doctor and we are not going to go there again. Terrible experience!!!
The best vet for any one to go to if you care and love for your fur baby they are very sweet ppl. And good to you fur baby thank you guys all the love

Dr White is a treasure. He takes time to listen and establishes a wonderful relationship with us and our animals. He respects our opinion, wishes, and limited budget and helps us help our pets be as happy and healthy as can be -without ever taking advantage of our love for our pets as part of our family. He takes time to explain things, share his wisdom  and allows us to make decisions that is best for our family without ever pushing anything. We will always be grateful to him for his kindness, his experience and expertise. He is the best dr, I only wish he could treat the rest of us humans :)
I've never seen a clinic like this before, they have specialists here for every problem your pet has. And the approach is absolutely great. They just do it with love.
Great staff.

Tried to call to see if I could admit my cat for help and before I finished my sentence, the lady answering the phones interrupted me and said that the vet is going home and they couldn’t help. They were recommended by another clinic that actually tried to help. I believe the lady’s name was Kate she was rude for no reason.

It was my first time coming to this vet and wish I could rate it more start. Starting with the staff since they are the face of the facility. They were nice took my information(I liked that when I called in to schedule the appointment they informed me it was going to take a while to be seen) surely it did but it didn’t bother me since I was aware already. When I got called in the male nurse took all information about the guinea pig. Finally, when got to see Dr.White he was the best! Treated Pepe like it were his own making sure she gets back to normal. He explained the risks about having this kind of pets. What impacted me the most when we were having a conversation he tells me there’s plenty of vet that care for cats dogs someone needs to step up and take care of this type of animals. I was like wooow that’s right. I can tell he doesn’t just do what he does just for the $$$ but because he truly cares for exotic pets/animals. We definitely need more people like him. May God bless him 💖. At the check out it went well and smooth the gentleman his charisma was excellent.

I’ve been coming here for years to bring my bearded dragon. Today, I decided to drop her off. I arrived early, and the receptionist at the front who seemed to be having a rough morning already had a bit of an attitude. She pointed out that I didn’t bring my dragon in a carrier. That was my mistake, but it had never been an issue before. Then she told me there would be a day charge, which I hadn’t been charged for in the past. I said that was fine. Shortly after, an ogre man came out and handled my dragon a bit roughly. He also started giving me attitude about not having a carrier. I stayed calm and acknowledged my mistake, but he kept going on about it. I eventually said, “If this is going to be a problem, I’ll just take my dragon back.”
As he walked away, he continued talking about the carrier issue. I told him that I wanted my dragon back. I just didn’t feel comfortable leaving her there. She’s very sick, and I want her to be handled with care. He then asked if I was sure I wanted to take her back, like of course I do. She’s my dragon.
It’s really disappointing. I used to love and trust this place. But the new staff who are frankly grumpy and unwelcoming have completely changed the experience. It’s a shame, especially since it’s so close to home.
New to this side of Houston and am very happy with the care and service from the doctor and all his staff!

I cannot highly recommend this place enough. Dr White & his staff are awesome & provide both compassionate & excellent care. Dr White takes cares of all my pets from my frog, to my cat, to my one eyed dog. Dr White is extremely knowledgeable on exotics as well as cats and dogs. I would give 10 stars if I could!
Dr. White is an incredible vet. He’s extremely knowledgeable and treats his patients with kindness and respect.
Wonderful doctor! Helpful staff! Great prices!

Got to update my review today 6/9/25. I brought a stray dog for exam and shots and Dr. White gave a little discount and I really appreciate that. Still took 40 minutes before I was seen so I’m deducting a star.

I also feel like the customers come here are very well behave on making sure their pets are not bother anybody.

I just had one of the best experiences of my life at Briarcrest veterinary clinic. From the moment I walked in the staff was very welcoming and kind, and Dr. White is probably the nicest man I’ve ever met in my life. I just adopted a sulcata  tortoise and I really don’t know much about them. Dr. White sat with me understanding my concerns and made me feel very comfortable. He was very informative. Very patient with me and gave me a lot of information on how to care for my new friend. I highly recommend this clinic to everyone.
And I’m very happy to say my Little Rock puppy is healthy!!!

Wonderful people working here especially Barbara who helped me out when I came in with a stray and guided me on the right direction.  And they were kind enough to let me hold some equipment until I was available to bring it back
Everyone was very caring and knowledgeable. Facilities were tidy and prices were lower than anticipated. Happy to have found Dr. White and his team!

Dr Larry white is a cut above the rest. His kindness, love for the animals, old school approach to care and time spent with the people is unmatched by anyone. He takes as much time with you as you need, gives detailed and expert advice and is extremely gentle and compassionate for all the animals. He has a loving heart and should be recognized as the best vet in Houston or anywhere. He's one of God's angels. His staff is great too.
We've been going to Dr. White for 20 years for our dogs and cat. He is the most caring vet that I've ever known. The staff are awesome and very kind as well.

Not only is Dr. White and the crew are legit professional and caring, even the fellow pet lovers are friendly folk too. The way he handled my Russian Tortoise during the trim beak was a treat to watch firsthand. I don't think many vets would let their owners watch such a thing; very cool. The whole place has this southern hospitality energy and will likely bring my dog here for annuals from now on.

They had a cool cat roaming around, very friendly.

BRIARCREST VET CLINIC (Dr. White is the founder). He has been in this same spot for nearly 50 years. He was telling me he had put a deposit in the late 70s  before the center was even built. Dr. White has genuinely tried to "help people" - help their most loved pets.  The doctor and his staff sincerely care.  In my opinion, with all the vets I've gone to, there isn't a more genuine, caring place to bring your "family member" for all their care. Dogs, cats. Birds, reptiles. Dr. White and his staff have helped this community.  They helped wholeheartedly as they could.

There is one vet I recommend.

BRIARCREST VET CLINIC AT BRIAR FOREST AND WILCREST IN HOUSTON TX.
This is a great place if you’re not in rush. They give you late appointment as they’re very busy. Doctor White is very nice but sometimes you need to ask him whatever you want.

I cannot recommend this veterinary clinic enough!!!!! Dr. White is AMAZING!!!!!!!! I have been coming here for about 2 years with my rabbits and now my 6 week old kitten! You can tell the Doctor and staff genuinely care about animals! Such a friendly and welcoming environment, thank you for everything you do❤️

And then they charged my card an extra $50 by mistake. I would stay away from this clinic unless you want to get told different things through the whole process.

Dr. White and his staff went above and beyond to cure my cat, whereas other clinics in Houston did more harm than good. I'm forever grateful for saving my furbaby. His long tenure in medicine was evident by solving my cat's complex case. He is very kind, humble and considerate in cost, and hence dedicated to his profession for the right reasons...which unfortunately is hard to find nowadays. Thank you Dr. White and Josue! 💓

Dr. White is incredible! I’d taken my pet to other veterinarians who could not help him with his skin issues. But Dr. White knew exactly what to do and my pet is so much better and happier. Thank you, Dr. White.

This was my first time here. I brought in my chameleon to get a checkup and fecal test. I arrived 15 minutes early and checked in and filled out paperwork. They called me back to the room at 10:30am which was my appointment time. They checked the wait at my chameleon at that time and then I waited in that room for a COMPLETE hour until the doc came in at 11:30am. For that reason alone I will NOT be going back. He then tries to stick this big flushing needle in that's absolutely too big before realizing it and switches it out. Other than that the doc was informative and tested the poop and gave the all clear. But like I said having to wait an hour after my appointment time is unacceptable and defeats the purpose of a set appointment time.
